description_target.ambiguity_notes: The executable rule reasons over each non-background 4-connected monochrome component's bounding box. A third component blocks a proposed bridge only when it has the same color as the endpoints and its bounding box intersects the proposed bridge rectangle.
negative_constraints: Do not connect components of different colors.
Do not connect horizontally unless the row bounding boxes overlap, the column bounding boxes are disjoint, and the row-midpoint sums are equal.
Do not connect vertically unless the column bounding boxes overlap, the row bounding boxes are disjoint, and the column-midpoint sums are equal.
Suppress a candidate bridge when a third same-color component's bounding box intersects its bridge rectangle.
solution_steps: Extract every non-background 4-connected monochrome component and its color and bounding box.
Enumerate same-color component pairs and identify horizontal or vertical candidates using perpendicular overlap, separation on the bridge axis, and equal midpoint sums.
Define each bridge as the full facing-edge gap across the interior of the perpendicular overlap.
Discard any candidate whose bridge rectangle intersects a third same-color component bounding box.
Paint every remaining bridge rectangle cyan (8), preserving all other cells.
description_target.source: independent semantic review of canonical examples and executable Racket rule
description_target.target_text: Connect midpoint-aligned same-color component bounding boxes with cyan bridges across the full facing-edge gap and the interior of their perpendicular overlap, unless a third same-color bounding box blocks the bridge.
